blocks.text: Sleek Socket Original & Patented Flat Ultra-Thin Outlet Concealer with Extension Cord Kit, Multi Outlets Power Strip, Ideal for Home Improvement, Hide Bulky and Messy Cords, 3ft

items: 𝗚𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗸𝗶𝘁𝗰𝗵𝗲𝗻𝘀, 𝘀𝗺𝗮𝗹𝗹 𝘀𝗽𝗼𝘁𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗯𝗲𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗱 𝗳𝘂𝗿𝗻𝗶𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲 -- Now you can discreetly and completely hide the entire outlet with our outlet and cord concealer kit, while also enhancing your home décor! The flat extension cord provides a sleek solution for managing plugs and cables, creating a clutter-free environment. The 3-foot cord is ideal for keeping your space tidy and organized when you're looking to optimize small areas or improve the aesthetics of your home.

𝗘𝗹𝗶𝗺𝗶𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝘂𝗴𝗹𝘆, 𝘂𝗻𝘀𝗮𝗳𝗲 𝗯𝘂𝗹𝗸𝘆 𝗽𝗹𝘂𝗴𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗰𝗼𝗿𝗱𝘀 -- Less is MORE. Less clutter, less hazards, and less obstacles. This ultra-thin, wall-hugging device blends with the wall – you’ll forget it’s there! Perfect for any room, this sleek device enhances the visual appeal of your home while providing a practical solution to manage your outlets.

𝗡𝗼 𝘁𝗼𝗼𝗹𝘀 𝗿𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗱! -- Simply attach to the top receptacle of a duplex outlet like a traditional plug. This user-friendly design allows for quick and easy attachment without the need for any tools. Perfect for anyone looking to simplify their home setup without undergoing a DIY project.

𝗜𝗻𝗰𝗹𝘂𝗱𝗲𝘀 𝗔𝗱𝗵𝗲𝘀𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗖𝗼𝗿𝗱 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗮𝗹𝗲𝗿 𝗞𝗶𝘁 -- Consisting of double sided, removable adhesive strips and adhesive cord clips to neatly secure the cord to the wall. You deserve a simple solution that is cost effective and keeps your cords neatly organized and out of sight!

𝗨𝗻𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗮𝗹𝗹𝘆 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗯𝗹𝗲 -- Works with all standard duplex outlet sizes featuring a round ground pin below the flat pins (see attached thumbnail). This ensures a versatile fit for various outlets, making it easy to use with different setups. Whether you're organizing cords in your kitchen or discreetly concealing outlets behind furniture, Sleek Socket offers a reliable fit for various setups while keeping your space neat and efficient.
𝗚𝗮𝗶𝗻 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗼𝘂𝘁𝗹𝗲𝘁𝘀! -- Not only will you eliminate clutter, but you will also gain more usable outlets as this 3-foot standard outlet concealer includes a 3-outlet power strips!
𝗗𝗲𝘀𝗶𝗴𝗻𝗲𝗱 𝗶𝗻 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗨𝗦𝗔, 𝗯𝘆 𝗮 𝗳𝗮𝗺𝗶𝗹𝘆-𝗼𝘄𝗻𝗲𝗱 𝘀𝗺𝗮𝗹𝗹 𝗯𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘀 -- Sleek Socket has safety certifications under all applicable UL Standards, ensuring that each product meets the highest safety requirements.
